name: OVERTURE Easy Nylon @BBL A1
filament_notes:
OVERTURE manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 95 C for 7 h.
Manufacturer max speed 70 mm/s.
ABRASIVE: fit a hardened nozzle on this printer first.
Manufacturer recommends an enclosure; this printer is open-frame.
Page + TDS V5.1: 245-260 C, bed 50 C (single value), 30-70 mm/s, fan off, dry 95 C/7 h, retraction 40-60 mm/s, density 1.12, Vicat 181.2 C. 'Enclosed Printer Required' (FAQ: recommended). 'Hardened Nozzle Recommended' - TDS: brass nozzle abrasion 'happens quite often', hardened steel/ruby 'highly recommended'. Anneal 70 C/2 h (TDS) or 80 C/6 h (FAQ) after printing.
Source: https://overture3d.com/products/easy-nylon-filament
